get.summary: Get All Resource Requests for a Single Project
get.description: Retrieves all Resource Requests for a specified Project within a company. This is a pageable endpoint.

parameters.name: company_id
parameters.description:
Unique identifier for the company. This parameter accepts both formats:
- **Recommended**: Procore company ID (integer) - Use this for new integrations
- Legacy: LaborChart UUID format (uuid string) - Supported for backward compatibility

A proxy layer automatically handles both formats, but using the Procore company ID is preferred for consistency with other Procore APIs.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description:
This is a **0-based index** representing the page slice of the data you want to retrieve. Each page contains up to **400 items**.
### **📌 Pageable Endpoints** People endpoints that return multiple records **support pagination**. It is recommended to use this feature to prevent network timeouts from excessively large data requests.
### **📌 Response Structure** A successful response will include the following properties:
- **`possible_pages`** *(integer)* → Total number of pages available to retrieve all data. - **`current_page`** *(integer)* → The **0-based index** of the page retrieved. - **`data`** *(array)* → List of records returned for the requested page (up to 400 items per page).
If a **page value exceeds** `possible_pages`, the `data` property will return an **empty array**.

schema.description: A paginated collection of Resource Requests.

possible_pages.description: The total number of pages available for pagination.

data.description: The list of Resource Requests on the current page.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Resource Request.

creator_id.description: ID of the user who created the Resource Request, if applicable.

project_id.description: ID of the project associated with this Resource Request.

start_day.description: The start date for the requested resource (MM/DD/YY).

end_day.description: The end date for the requested resource (MM/DD/YY).

start_time.description: The start time of the requested resource.

end_time.description: The end time of the requested resource.

percent_allocated.description: The percentage allocation of the requested resource if applicable.

job_title_id.description: ID of the Job Title associated with the Resource Request.

category_id.description: ID of the Project Category associated with the Resource Request.

subcategory_id.description: ID of the Project Subcategory associated with the Resource Request.

state_id.description: ID of the Assignment State associated with the Resource Request.

work_scope_text.description: Description of the work scope for the requested resource.

instruction_text.description: Instructions related to the requested resource.

work_days.description: Object representing workdays for the requested resource, using a 0-based index (Sunday-Saturday).

error.description: If you receive a 401 error, please ensure you are following the OAuth 2.0 guidelines outlined at https://developers.procore.com/documentation/introduction and verify you can successfully call the /me endpoint using your access token. Additionally, the user associated with that token must be added as a user in the Workforce Planning People List for the corresponding company.

post.summary: Create a Resource Request on a Project
post.description: Creates a new Resource Request for a specified project within a given company. Resource requests can be based on work hours (start_time and end_time) or percent allocation (percent_allocated).

parameters.name: company_id
parameters.description:
Unique identifier for the company. This parameter accepts both formats:
- **Recommended**: Procore company ID (integer) - Use this for new integrations
- Legacy: LaborChart UUID format (uuid string) - Supported for backward compatibility

A proxy layer automatically handles both formats, but using the Procore company ID is preferred for consistency with other Procore APIs.

schema.description: Request body schema for creating a Resource Request.

start_day.description: The first day the requested resource is needed (ISO 8601).

end_day.description: The last day the requested resource is needed (ISO 8601).

start_time.description: Start time of the request (HH:MM am/pm format).

end_time.description: End time of the request (HH:MM am/pm format).

percent_allocated.description: Allocation percentage if the request is not hour-based.

quantity.description: Number of resource requests to create.

job_title_id.description: Job Title UUID for this request.

work_scope_text.description: Scope of Work for the Resource Request.

work_days.description: Object to control working days (Sunday - Saturday as 0-6 index).

id.description: Unique identifier for the Resource Request.

project_id.description: Project ID where the request is created.

job_title_id.description: Job Title UUID for this request.

work_scope_text.description: Scope of Work for the Resource Request.

error.description: If you receive a 401 error, please ensure you are following the OAuth 2.0 guidelines outlined at https://developers.procore.com/documentation/introduction and verify you can successfully call the /me endpoint using your access token. Additionally, the user associated with that token must be added as a user in the Workforce Planning People List for the corresponding company.
